args.body: Use the saved help index under the existing marketplace mission. Prioritize the direct fee and processor documents for the intended Canadian seller. If there is a supported activation path, verify one package's file-specific commercial redistribution rights and run the exact download contents from a clean directory. Deliver the bilingual listing and operator activation handoff with the observed output and a clearly labeled price hypothesis. If activation depends on an unresolved term, identify that term and what would establish it. Read back before closing with a lesson. Public release still needs independent review of the exact candidate. No account creation, listing or spending.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. In parallel, verify whether Payhip offers a viable checkout for an existing package. Public release still requires host-enforced independent review of the exact candidate.
